card.name: Geography text about mountains and land
card.fires_on: Words and small linking words inside geography or earth-science passages, such as 'of' after development or roots, or 'mountain' in 'old mountain chains'. It also fires on digits and commas in land-area figures.

modes.label: Mountain-building passages
modes.description: Linking words or 'mountain' in text on mountain chains and metamorphic rock.
modes.example: and temperatures during the development<< of>> mountain chains along boundaries between crustal plates

modes.label: Country size and area figures
modes.description: Commas, digits or small words in land-area numbers and national statistics.
modes.example: Uruguay is the smallest Spanishspeaking nation in South America with a land area of 176<<,>>220 square kilometers, slightly smaller

modes.label: Share or proportion of a whole
modes.description: The word 'of' after a proportion or percentage in country or population facts.
modes.example: Isle of Pines. New Caledonia is also one of the world's top "biodiversity hotspots" with over 76%<< of>> it's plants being endemic.

card.writes: It nudges the output toward river, invaded and armed-force words, and away from candidate and association words.
card.plain: It fires on filler words and numbers in passages about mountains, countries and land areas.
